description: The signed-in person's one livedot LiveTrack address for Garmin Connect (the same address in Windline, RunFast and AdventureLive): added once as a LiveTrack recipient in the Garmin Connect app, every activity they start on their Garmin with LiveTrack on shows live on livedot. Returns the address, the set-up steps from the help article, when the last LiveTrack link arrived, and the help link. Say the steps as given; never add a safety feature the answer doesn't give. field: true also gives a link code for the livedot data field on a Garmin (Connect IQ), a W (Windline, rides) or R (RunFast, runs) code: Garmin Connect → Connect IQ apps → livedot → Settings → Link code; one use, 10 minutes; both: true gives one of each. Only when the user asks for the data field or its code.

both.description: With field: one Windline and one RunFast code (Link code and Second link code).

field.description: true: also a link code for the livedot data field (Connect IQ). Only when the user asks for it.

sport.description: With field: ride for a Windline (W) code, run for a RunFast (R) code. Leave it out for the account they have.

name: garmin_livetrack

outputSchema.description: Their Garmin LiveTrack address, how to set it up once, when its last link arrived; with field, a data field link code.

address.description: Their one livedot LiveTrack address (the same in Windline, RunFast and AdventureLive).

app.description: The account's app: windline or runfast.

codes.description: Only with field: the data field's codes: app (windline: W, rides; runfast: R, runs), sport, code, expires_at (ISO, 10 minutes on).

error.description: When the call failed: what went wrong, in words for the user.

last_link_at.description: When the last LiveTrack link arrived (ISO), or null.

message.description: When view is "none": what to tell the user (no match, not live yet, a question back).

missing.description: Asked for but not connected: the app, in words.

signup.description: Without a sign-in: { label, url } to make a free Windline or RunFast account (?ref=mcp).

sponsor_line.description: The line every answer ends with: who brings livedot's live tracking free.

status.description: The last link, in words ("Last link received 5 min ago").

steps.description: The help article's own set-up steps, in order.

view.description: What this answer is; "none" when there is nothing to show (see message).

title: Garmin LiveTrack
